response.sql: WITH linked_fees AS (SELECT o.orderbase, f.feerate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), channel_avgs AS (SELECT orderbase, AVG(feerate) AS avg_fee_rate FROM linked_fees GROUP BY orderbase), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(feerate) AS avg_fee_rate FROM linked_fees) SELECT AVG(c.avg_fee_rate) AS mean_channel_fee_rate, AVG(c.avg_fee_rate - b.avg_fee_rate) AS mean_excess_fee_rate FROM channel_avgs AS c CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE c.avg_fee_rate > b.avg_fee_rate
